  "openApiYaml": "openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  title: URL Shortener API
  version: 1.0.0
  description: |
    Creates short links and redirects short codes to their target URLs.

    All errors are RFC 9457 problem documents (`application/problem+json`). `type` is omitted
    when it is `about:blank`; `instance` is the request path. Operational endpoints
    (`/actuator/health`, `/actuator/info`, `/actuator/metrics`) are not part of this contract.
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:8080

paths:
  /api/v1/links:
    post:
      operationId: createLink
      summary: Create a short link
      description: |
        Creates a link with a random 7-character base62 code, or with `customAlias` as the code.
        Rate limited per client IP (default 20 requests per minute, token bucket).
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/CreateLinkRequest'
            examples:
              generated:
                value:
                  url: https://example.com/some/long/path
              customAliasWithExpiry:
                value:
                  url: https://example.com/launch
                  customAlias: launch-2026
                  expiresAt: '2026-12-31T23:59:59Z'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Link created.
          headers:
            Location:
              description: Absolute URL of the link's metadata resource (`{baseUrl}/api/v1/links/{code}`).
              schema:
                type: string
                format: uri
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/LinkResponse'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest'
        '409':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/AliasConflict'
        '415':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/UnsupportedMediaType'
        '429':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/TooManyRequests'
        '500':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/InternalServerError'

  /api/v1/links/{code}:
    parameters:
      - name: code
        in: path
        required: true
        description: The short code.
        schema:
          type: string
    get:
      operationId: getLink
      summary: Get link metadata
      description: Returns the link, including expired links. Deleted links are not found.
      responses:
        '200':
          description: The link.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/LinkResponse'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound'
        '500':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/InternalServerError'
    delete:
      operationId: deleteLink
      summary: Delete a link
      description: |
        Soft-deletes the link and evicts it from the redirect cache. The code is never reused:
        creating a link with the same alias afterwards returns 409.
      responses:
        '204':
          description: Link deleted.
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound'
        '500':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/InternalServerError'

  /api/v1/links/{code}/stats:
    parameters:
      - name: code
        in: path
        required: true
        description: The short code for which to retrieve statistics.
        schema:
          type: string
    get:
      operationId: getLinkStats
      summary: Get link click statistics
      description: Returns total clicks, time of last click, and daily click counts for the last 7 days for a given short code.
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Link click statistics.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/LinkStatsResponse'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound'
        '500':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/InternalServerError'

  /{code}:
    parameters:
      - name: code
        in: path
        required: true
        description: |
          The short code. Paths that do not match the pattern are not routed to this operation
          and return 404.
        schema:
          type: string
          pattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{4,32}$'
    get:
      operationId: redirect
      summary: Redirect to the target URL
      description: |
        Responds with `302 Found` (not 301) and `Cache-Control: no-store`, so browsers do not
        cache the redirect and every visit reaches the service. For every successful redirect,
        click analytics (timestamp, referrer host, user-agent family) are recorded asynchronously.
      responses:
        '302':
          description: Redirect to the target URL.
          headers:
            Location:
              description: The target URL.
              schema:
                type: string
                format: uri
            Cache-Control:
              description: Always `no-store`.
              schema:
                type: string
                const: no-store
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound'
        '410':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Gone'
        '500':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/InternalServerError'

components:
  schemas:
    CreateLinkRequest:
      type: object
      required: [url]
      properties:
        url:
          type: string
          format: uri
          maxLength: 2048
          description: |
            Absolute `http` or `https` URL with a host. Rejected (400) if it contains user info
            (e.g. `https://bank.com@evil.com`), points at the shortener's own host, or is longer
            than 2048 characters. Leading and trailing whitespace is trimmed.
          examples: ['https://example.com/some/long/path']
        customAlias:
          type: string
          pattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{4,32}$'
          description: |
            Optional code to use instead of a generated one. Reserved words (case-insensitive):
            api, actuator, health, admin, static, assets, public, login, logout, error, favicon,
            robots, metrics, info, docs, swagger, openapi, www.
          examples: [launch-2026]
        expiresAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: Optional ISO-8601 instant; must be in the future. Stored at microsecond precision.
          examples: ['2026-12-31T23:59:59Z']

    LinkResponse:
      type: object
      required: [code, shortUrl, targetUrl, createdAt, expiresAt]
      properties:
        code:
          type: string
          pattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{4,32}$'
          examples: [aZ3kP9q]
        shortUrl:
          type: string
          format: uri
          description: '`{baseUrl}/{code}`'
          examples: ['http://localhost:8080/aZ3kP9q']
        targetUrl:
          type: string
          format: uri
          examples: ['https://example.com/some/long/path']
        createdAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          examples: ['2026-01-01T00:00:00Z']
        expiresAt:
          type: [string, 'null']
          format: date-time
          description: '`null` when the link never expires.'
          examples: [null]

    LinkStatsResponse:
      type: object
      required: [totalClicks, lastClickAt, dailyCounts]
      properties:
        totalClicks:
          type: integer
          format: int64
          description: Total number of clicks for the link.
          examples: [5]
        lastClickAt:
          type: [string, 'null']
          format: date-time
          description: ISO-8601 instant of the last recorded click, or `null` if no clicks.
          examples: ['2023-10-27T10:30:00Z']
        dailyCounts:
          type: array
          description: Daily click counts for the last 7 days, in UTC, ordered from oldest to newest.
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/DailyClickCount'

    DailyClickCount:
      type: object
      required: [date, count]
      properties:
        date:
          type: string
          format: date
          description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format (UTC).
          examples: ['2023-10-21']
        count:
          type: integer
          format: int64
          description: Number of clicks on this date.
          examples: [1]

    ProblemDetail:
      type: object
      description: RFC 9457 problem document.
      required: [title, status, instance]
      properties:
        type:
          type: string
          format: uri-reference
          description: Omitted when `about:blank`.
        title:
          type: string
          description: |
            Short summary. Application errors use: `Invalid request`, `Link not found`,
            `Link expired`, `Alias already in use`, `Too many requests`,
            `Short code generation failed`, `Internal server error`. Framework errors (e.g.
            malformed JSON, unsupported media type) use the HTTP reason phrase.
        status:
          type: integer
        detail:
          type: string
        instance:
          type: string
          format: uri-reference
          description: The request path.
        errors:
          type: array
          description: Present on `Invalid request` (400) problems.
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/FieldViolation'

    FieldViolation:
      type: object
      required: [field, message]
      properties:
        field:
          type: string
          examples: [url]
        message:
          type: string
          examples: [must not be blank]

  responses:
    BadRequest:
      description: |
        Invalid request: bean validation failure (missing `url`), target URL or alias policy
        violation, expiry not in the future, or malformed / unparseable JSON.
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
          examples:
            validation:
              value:
                title: Invalid request
                status: 400
                detail: Request validation failed
                instance: /api/v1/links
                errors:
                  - field: url
                    message: must not be blank
            policy:
              value:
                title: Invalid request
                status: 400
                detail: url must not contain user info
                instance: /api/v1/links
                errors:
                  - field: url
                    message: must not contain user info
            malformedJson:
              value:
                title: Bad Request
                status: 400
                detail: Failed to read request
                instance: /api/v1/links
    NotFound:
      description: No active link exists for the code (never created, or deleted).
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
          example:
            title: Link not found
            status: 404
            detail: No link exists for code 'aZ3kP9q'
            instance: /aZ3kP9q
    Gone:
      description: The link exists but has expired.
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
          example:
            title: Link expired
            status: 410
            detail: The link for code 'aZ3kP9q' has expired
            instance: /aZ3kP9q
    AliasConflict:
      description: The custom alias is already in use (including by a deleted link).
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
          example:
            title: Alias already in use
            status: 409
            detail: The alias 'launch-2026' is already in use
            instance: /api/v1/links
    UnsupportedMediaType:
      description: The request body is not `application/json`.
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    TooManyRequests:
      description: The client exceeded the link-creation rate limit.
      headers:
        Retry-After:
          description: Seconds until the next request will be accepted (at least 1).
          schema:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
          example:
            title: Too many requests
            status: 429
            detail: Rate limit exceeded; retry after 3 seconds
            instance: /api/v1/links
    InternalServerError:
      description: |
        Unexpected failure, or no unique code could be generated within 5 attempts
        (`Short code generation failed`).
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
",
  "dataModel": "CREATE TABLE clicks (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    link_id UUID NOT NULL,
    clicked_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL,
    referrer_host VARCHAR(255),
    user_agent_family VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (link_id) REFERENCES links(id)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_clicks_link_id ON clicks (link_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_clicks_clicked_at ON clicks (clicked_at);
CREATE INDEX idx_clicks_link_id_clicked_at ON clicks (link_id, clicked_at DESC);",
  "decisions": [
    {
      "title": "Click Tracking Trigger",
      "choice": "Record click analytics only for successful HTTP 302 Found redirects.",
      "rationale": "This aligns with the definition of a 'successful redirect' as per FR-1 and Q-1, indicating that the client was successfully directed to the target URL. Other 3xx responses (e.g., 301 Moved Permanently) might imply a different intent or a permanent change, which is not the primary focus for 'click' analytics in this context. A 410 Gone response for expired links will not trigger click recording, as it's not a redirect.",
      "alternatives": [
        "Record for any HTTP 3xx response.",
        "Record for any request that results in a redirect, even if the target is invalid."
      ]
    },
    {
      "title": "User-Agent Family Classification",
      "choice": "Use the 'ua-parser-java' library for determining the coarse user-agent family (browser, bot, other).",
      "rationale": "As recommended by Q-2, a well-maintained, lightweight third-party library provides a good balance of accuracy, robustness, and maintainability compared to custom regex or simpler heuristics. 'ua-parser-java' is a suitable choice for this purpose.",
      "alternatives": [
        "Implement custom regex-based logic.",
        "Use a simpler heuristic (e.g., check for common bot strings)."
      ]
    },
    {
      "title": "API Response for Non-Existent Link Statistics",
      "choice": "The GET /api/v1/links/{code}/stats endpoint will return HTTP 404 Not Found if the short code does not exist.",
      "rationale": "As per Q-3, if the resource (the link itself) does not exist, an HTTP 404 is the semantically correct response. Returning 200 OK with zero counts would imply the resource exists but has no data, which is misleading.",
      "alternatives": [
        "Return HTTP 200 OK with zero counts and null last click.",
        "Return HTTP 400 Bad Request."
      ]
    },
    {
      "title": "Time Zone for Daily Click Counts",
      "choice": "Daily click counts in the /api/v1/links/{code}/stats API will be calculated and presented in UTC.",
      "rationale": "As recommended by Q-4, UTC provides a consistent, unambiguous global standard for time-series data. This simplifies aggregation, avoids issues with daylight saving changes, and ensures that daily boundaries are interpreted uniformly regardless of the server's or client's local time zone.",
      "alternatives": [
        "Use the server's local time zone.",
        "Allow the client to request a specific time zone via a header."
      ]
    },
    {
      "title": "Handling Missing or Malformed Referrer Host",
      "choice": "If the Referer header is missing or cannot be parsed into a valid host, the 'referrer_host' field in the click record will be stored as 'null'.",
      "rationale": "As recommended by Q-5, storing 'null' prevents data loss, simplifies analysis by clearly indicating the absence of data, and avoids storing potentially invalid or malformed strings. This approach is straightforward and robust.",
      "alternatives": [
        "Store as an empty string.",
        "Log an error and discard the referrer data entirely."
      ]
    },
    {
      "title": "Asynchronous Click Recording",
      "choice": "Click recording will be implemented as an asynchronous operation using Spring's `@Async` with a dedicated `TaskExecutor`.",
      "rationale": "This decision directly addresses NFR-1 (performance) by decoupling the analytics write path from the critical redirect path. The redirect endpoint (GET /{code}) can return quickly, while click data is processed in the background, ensuring minimal impact on P99 latency. A dedicated `TaskExecutor` prevents resource contention with other asynchronous tasks.",
      "alternatives": [
        "Synchronous click recording (rejected due to NFR-1 performance impact).",
        "Using a message queue (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ) for click events (rejected as it adds significant operational complexity for basic analytics and is overkill for the current scale, though it could be a future enhancement).",
        "Batching clicks in memory and writing periodically (rejected due to potential data loss on crash and increased complexity)."
      ]
    },
    {
      "title": "Expired Link Handling with Caching",
      "choice": "The Caffeine cache will store full `Link` objects, and the `LinkResolver` will explicitly check the `expiresAt` field of the cached `Link` object on every resolution, even on a cache hit.",
      "rationale": "This approach ensures that expired links consistently return HTTP 410 Gone within 1 minute of their `expiresAt` timestamp passing, as required by FR-3 and NFR-4. By storing the full `Link` object, the expiry check becomes an integral part of the cache lookup logic, effectively 'invalidating' expired links at read time without complex cache eviction strategies. This is simpler and more reliable than relying solely on time-based cache eviction which might not be granular enough or prone to race conditions.",
      "alternatives": [
        "Using a cache with a short TTL (Time-To-Live) for redirects (rejected because it might not meet the 1-minute expiry guarantee and could lead to unnecessary cache misses for non-expired links).",
        "Implementing a background job to periodically invalidate expired links from the cache (rejected due to increased complexity, potential for race conditions, and difficulty in guaranteeing the 1-minute window).",
        "Storing only the target URL in the cache and always hitting the database for `expiresAt` (rejected due to performance impact on the redirect path, violating the goal of maintaining performance)."
      ]
    }
  ],
  "risks": [
    "Performance degradation of the redirect service due to synchronous analytics recording. Mitigation: Click recording will be implemented as an asynchronous operation using Spring's @Async with a dedicated TaskExecutor. This decouples the analytics write path from the critical redirect path. P99 latency of GET /{code} will be closely monitored before and after deployment. This risk is accepted with the mitigation of asynchronous processing.",
    "Data integrity issues with click counts or timestamps. Mitigation: The ClickRepository will use robust JDBC operations, ensuring transactional writes for click recording. For asynchronous processing, Spring's default error handling for @Async methods will be relied upon, with monitoring for any failures. Data consistency will be regularly audited. This risk is accepted with standard database practices and monitoring.",
    "Security vulnerability due to user-agent parsing library. Mitigation: A well-vetted and actively maintained third-party library ('ua-parser-java') will be used for user-agent parsing. Code reviews will focus on input sanitization and error handling around user-agent processing. The library will be kept updated. This risk is accepted with careful library selection and security practices.",
    "Cache invalidation logic for expired links is complex and introduces new bugs. Mitigation: The LinkResolver will be modified to store full 'Link' objects in the Caffeine cache. The 'resolve' method will explicitly check the 'expiresAt' field of the cached 'Link' object on every request, even on a cache hit. This simplifies the cache logic by centralizing the expiry check. Thorough unit and integration tests will cover edge cases around 'expiresAt' and cache interactions. This risk is accepted with a simplified design and comprehensive testing.",
    "Storage cost increase due to click data. Mitigation: Storage growth for the 'clicks' table will be monitored. If necessary, future iterations may implement data archiving or purging policies for older, raw click records, retaining only aggregated daily counts for long-term trends. This risk is accepted with a plan for future data management if growth becomes an issue."
  ]
}
